title: Permanent background summaries hide the mechanical effect
body:
The consequence that decides the quest is not visible when you choose.

`albany:relief_registration` presents four permanent backgrounds as summaries. Road
Warden's summary says, in full:

    Starts with: Fieldcraft 4; weatherproof field kit
    Immediate cost: no fee or delay; start with $12
    Tradeoff: Return Hayden's winter packet with an honest report

Read-only inspection of the same option returns, among other things:

    "In Wolf-Winter, Defense starts at 4 instead of 3."

That is the mechanical difference that actually shows up in play — a live-test lead
independently measured backgrounds changing Defense 4 vs 3 and fieldcraft 4/mediation 0
vs 0/4 — and it is absent from the summary a player chooses from. Every option carries
`consequence: ""` at the summary level, so no option shows its mechanical effect until
inspected.

The choice is permanent and arrives at decision 2 or 3, so the summaries are what most
players will decide on. Inspection is optional, easy to skip, and there is no prompt
suggesting the summaries are incomplete.

The inspected text is genuinely good. The problem is only that it is hidden behind a call
a player has no reason to make. Surfacing one line of mechanical effect per option in the
summary would close it without new content.

evidence.summary: Defense 4 vs 3 appears only under inspect; summaries carry an empty consequence.
